title: Variable letter and numeral families

slide_intent: Test more than a single logo because a usable expressive type system must handle multiple letters and numbers.
strategic_value: Repeated A–F and 1–3 specimens can demonstrate a common behavior across Symphony messaging.
demonstration: A three-by-three grid of repeated characters grows, shrinks and slants in staggered sequences on white.
practical_value: Compare the same deformation across letters and numerals before composing new copy.
